captions:
1:01.81 on the board. 1:01.60 in the tank. ⏱️

Kart Connect splits every lap into three sectors and builds your theoretical best from your quickest ones.

That's 0.21s you've already driven, just never in the same lap. Now you know exactly where to find it. 🏁
